sources.title: FastFlowLM/MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B-NPU2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: OpenVINO™ is an open-source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference on Intel CPU/GPU/NPU platforms. OpenVINO provides day-0 support for MiniCPM-V-4.7 on Intel platforms with high-performance inference.

sources.title: MiniCPM · FastFlowLM
sources.snippet: Pictures work as on MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B: a downscaled view of the whole image plus up to 9 tiles, so the --img-pre-resize (-r) option has no effect on this model. The text side is the same engine as qwen3.6-moe:35b-a3b (same layer layout, same NPU kernels); only the vision side differs.
